name: Office of the University Secretary / Board Secretary
statement: To maintain open lines of communication between Board members and University officials

name: Management Information Systems Department
statement: To keep technological infrastructures accessible and up to date to respond to evolving service demands

name: Data Protection Department
statement: To monitor the University’s compliance with all applicable data protection laws and policies

name: Colleges and Senior High School
statement: To ensure that academic programs are continually upgraded to maintain high standards of quality and excellence

name: Office of the University Registrar
statement: To ensure an efficient system for managing student records, which will aid Pamantasan ng Cabuyao in the promotion and implementation of its educational programs.

name: Office of the University Library
statement: To provide innovative library services with relevant and updated resources among teaching and non-teaching personnel, students, and outside researchers, which will support the University’s instructional and learning programs

name: University Health Department
statement: To provide quality medical and dental care to the students and personnel, which will allow them to perform optimally

name: Laboratory Services and Disaster Risk Reduction Management Department
statement: To reduce the vulnerability to and impact of disasters at the University and provide quality laboratory service and assistance to teaching personnel and students, who are conducting technical and scientific investigations

name: Property Management and General Services Department
statement: To continue upgrading the physical infrastructure and facilities, to ensure an effective and efficient procurement and inventory services, and to safeguard the assets and personnel that would make Pamantasan ng Cabuyao (University of Cabuyao) conducive to learning

name: Human Resource Management Department
statement: To ensure that the teaching and non-teaching personnel at Pamantasan ng Cabuyao (University of Cabuyao) consistently grow personally and professionally through initiatives that maximize their potential for the advancement of overall human development.

name: Entrepreneurship and Business Development Department
statement: To contribute and support the sustainability of the institution through implementation of income and long-term impact development projects.

name: Finance Department
statement: To ensure effective financial management and compliance by maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records, developing and monitoring budgets, optimizing financial performance, and providing excellent customer service while following proper accounting and cash handling procedures.

name: Quality Management and Planning Department
statement: To ensure organizational efficiency and continuous improvement through accreditation and certification

name: Community and Extension Services Department
statement: To develop, disseminate, and implement research-based, relevant, innovative, and sustainable extension and services programs that will improve the quality of life of the target clientele

name: Research and Development Department
statement: To transform the PnC (UC) academic community into research-competent teaching and non-teaching personnel and students who can enhance human knowledge and apply research results to genuine needs in the community and society

name: Knowledge Management and Innovation Department
statement: To improve the university’s organizational efficiency by utilizing information and communication technologies for knowledge development, production, and dissemination, as well as by applying for patents and intellectual property protection

name: Student Affairs and Services Department
statement: To provide a variety of activities geared at students that will complement their academic studies and advance their entire development as productive players in nation-building

name: Sports and Development Department
statement: To develop and enhance student-athletes’ character, skills, and talents through physical activities and sport opportunities, as well as an efficient training program who will represent the university in local, national, regional, and international competitions

name: Guidance and Counseling Department
statement: To foster and improve students’ academic, social, emotional and personal development in order to ensure individual student success in current and future endeavors

name: Admissions Department
statement: To recruit and communicate with prospective and admitted students using an efficient technology-enabled process

name: Placement, Alumni, and Linkage Department
statement: To engage with beneficial alliances with enterprises, industries, educational institutions, and private or public companies or agencies that will aid the university in achieving its objectives and mission and enhance the standard of its academic program.

name: Gender and Development Department
statement: To create initiatives that promote gender-inclusiveness and gender-sensitive spaces within the University
